sinopsis.es: Objetos, grabaciones y recuerdos ayudan a procesar la pérdida de una pareja.
sinopsis.en: Rafael just lost Mariano. What is left are objects, recordings, words trapped in a voice recorder and a box full of memories. In an attempt to sustain himself, he embarks on a journey with Larisa and Joel—two friends with their own ghosts—where little by little the words of other broken hearts begin to weave a new way of understanding mourning. A story about what we have left after love: the echo, the voice, and the other half of the pain.
